verdict.rationale: Letta offers isolation-oriented options that could support sandbox-style testing: an --ephemeral CLI mode that runs one-shot tasks without persisting any agent, memory, or MemFS state (letta-docs-14), and a managed 'cloud sandbox' for running agents with no local setup (letta-docs-16, letta-docs-33, letta-docs-58). However, there is no explicit documentation of a staging/production environment separation or guarantee that testing won't touch production agent data. Missing for 10: explicit staging-vs-production environment concept, documentation of data isolation guarantees, and any evidence/testimonial confirming this workflow is used for safe testing.
